sources: Fri Aug 14 pre-US-open run. THEME: the volatility complex keeps collapsing while the labour tape cracks for the first time in months. Brent 87.18 Aug 14 (TradingEconomics), DOWN from 89.7 yesterday but roughly FLAT w/w - the IEA cut its 2026 demand outlook and OPEC trimmed growth to 580kb/d (4th consecutive downward revision), offsetting the Hormuz risk premium; market in wait-and-see on diplomacy to reopen the strait. VIX 14.63 Aug 13 close, DOWN from 15.28 and ~17 two weeks ago - a seven-month trough, options pricing only a 0.9% daily S&P swing. MOVE 72.0 Aug 13 (Investing/CNBC), DOWN from 75.5: bond vol now at the dormant end of its post-2021 range, both vol gauges collapsing together. 10Y-2Y +0.48 Aug 12 (FRED T10Y2Y), UP from 0.46 Aug 7 - slow bear-steepening continues, no re-flattening. T5YIFR 2.28% Aug 12 (FRED), DOWN from 2.31 Aug 11, flat vs 2.28 Aug 7 - breakevens gave back the crude-driven pop, back below the 2.3 threshold. HY OAS 271bp Aug 12 (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2, 2.71%), flat vs 270 Aug 7 - pinned in the richest decile, ~180bp inside the long-run median, zero cushion if growth data turns. BDTI ~2690 Aug 13 (StockQ, cross-checked vs Barchart 2671 Aug 11; reconstructed, +/-20pts), UP ~4.5% w/w from ~2575 - tanker rates still climbing, TD3C at WS475 (+46 w/w), deepest red reading on the board. EUR/USD 3M xccy -10bp CARRIED - no free dated quote available; CME XEURBI moved +0.17 to +0.59 w/w (different convention) implying no funding stress. NFCI -0.549 wk Aug 7 (Chicago Fed, released Aug 12), marginally looser than -0.546 - a long run of gentle easing, no signal. Global liquidity 1=stable. DXY 99.85 Aug 14 (TradingEconomics) vs 99.57 Aug 7 - dollar chopping sideways, Fed-cut pricing not moving it. Copper 6.50/lb Aug 13 settle and Gold 4349.55/oz Aug 13 close (TradingEconomics) -> ratio 1.49, DOWN from ~1.51: copper came off its Aug 7 record 6.77 on soft China demand while gold holds near highs - a mildly negative growth signal, unlike last week's pure-gold move. CLAIMS ARE THE STORY: 209k wk Aug 8 (DOL, released Aug 13), UP 9k from 200k revised and well above the 202k consensus - the sub-200k streak, the longest since 1969, is broken; 4wk MA 199k unchanged and continuing claims fell 22k to 1.777m, so one print rather than a trend, but the first crack. ISM Manufacturing 55.6 July CARRIED (released Aug 3, highest since May 2022); August prints Sep 1. SOFR-OIS ~2bp CARRIED - no clean 3M quote available free; the SOFR-IORB proxy sits at -3bp, i.e. if anything easier, definitively no funding stress. LEI -1.4% YoY (June) CARRIED; note the Conference Board rebenchmarked the entire index history with the June release. July data Aug 20. Sahm Rule -0.03 July CARRIED (FRED SAHMREALTIME), no labour-recession trigger despite the claims uptick. UMich 55.2 July final CARRIED - the August PRELIM releases today at 10am ET, roughly four hours after this run, consensus ~54.1. Permits 1367k June CARRIED (-3.0% m/m), July release Aug 18. WATCH: UMich Aug prelim today 10am ET, permits Aug 18, LEI Aug 20, next claims Aug 20 to see whether 209k was noise.
